title: Transport the relative restriction diagram to opens of the union scheme
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and W,V opens, with derived categories of module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category] in common Hom universe w on X,W,V,W intersect V,W union V. All functors and comparisons are those of [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Put Y=(W union V).toScheme, U=Y.ι inverse image W, T=Y.ι inverse image V. Write L=D(restriction X to W union V), JW=D(restriction X to W), JV=D(restriction X to V), PW=D(relative restriction W union V to W), PV=D(relative restriction W union V to V), SW=D(relative restriction W to W intersect V), SV=D(relative restriction V to W intersect V). Write kW:L PW isomorphic to JW, kV:L PV isomorphic to JV, sW:JW SW isomorphic to direct intersection restriction, sV:JV SV isomorphic to direct intersection restriction for the canonical comparisons. There exist derived localizations in universe w on U,T,U intersect T, derived equivalences eW:D(U) equivalent to D(W), eV:D(T) equivalent to D(V), and natural isomorphisms qW:RU eW.functor isomorphic to PW and qV:RT eV.functor isomorphic to PV, where RU and RT are direct derived restrictions from Y. For every G,E in D(X) and a:JW(G) to JW(E), b:JV(G) to JV(E) satisfying sW(G) inverse followed by SW(a) followed by sW(E) = sV(G) inverse followed by SV(b) followed by sV(E), define a' as eW.functor.preimage of qW(LG) followed by kW(G) followed by a followed by kW(E) inverse followed by qW(LE) inverse, and similarly b'. Then tU(LG) inverse followed by SU(a') followed by tU(LE) = tT(LG) inverse followed by ST(b') followed by tT(LE), where SU,ST and tU,tT are the relative intersection restrictions and canonical comparisons in Y. This is only a transport identity; no local or global gluing assertion is made.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-mayer-vietoris-hom: canonical restriction diagram on W union V; Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf, overMapCompOverEquiv and overFunctorEquiv

proof.text: Obtain the derived comparison equivalences and the two overlap pasting identities from the canonical comparison diagram.

For each local morphism, map its transported overlap restriction through eI. Naturality of cW or cV, map_preimage and cancellation identify the result with qI(G) followed by its ambient overlap restriction followed by qI(E) inverse. The private comparison_conjugation lemma proves this calculation for arbitrary categories. Apply functorial congruence to the ambient compatibility hypothesis, rewrite both calculations and use faithfulness of eI.

proof_origin.note: Canonical comparison diagram followed by a complete categorical conjugation calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem open_union_restriction_transport
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    :
    let L := (schemeOpenRestriction X (W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let JW := (schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory
    let JV := (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory
    let SW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)).mapDerivedCategory
    let SV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let sW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)
    let sV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    let PW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let PV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let kW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)
    let kV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)
    let U := (W ⊔ V).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let T := (W ⊔ V).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V
      ∃ hU : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
      letI := hU
      ∃ hT : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
      letI := hT
      ∃ hI : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (U ⊓ T).toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
      letI := hI
      let RU := (schemeOpenRestriction (W ⊔ V).toScheme U).mapDerivedCategory
      let RT := (schemeOpenRestriction (W ⊔ V).toScheme T).mapDerivedCategory
      let SU := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction (W ⊔ V).toScheme
        (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ T ⟶ U)).mapDerivedCategory
      let ST := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction (W ⊔ V).toScheme
        (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ T ⟶ T)).mapDerivedCategory
      let tU := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso (W ⊔ V).toScheme
        (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ T ⟶ U)
      let tT := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso (W ⊔ V).toScheme
        (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ T ⟶ T)
      ∃ (eW : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ≌ schemeDerivedCategory W.toScheme)
        (eV : schemeDerivedCategory T.toScheme ≌ schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme)
        (qW : RU ⋙ eW.functor ≅ PW) (qV : RT ⋙ eV.functor ≅ PV),
      ∀ (G E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (a : JW.obj G ⟶ JW.obj E) (b : JV.obj G ⟶ JV.obj E),
        sW.inv.app G ≫ SW.map a ≫ sW.hom.app E =
          sV.inv.app G ≫ SV.map b ≫ sV.hom.app E →
        let a' := eW.functor.preimage
          (qW.hom.app (L.obj G) ≫ kW.hom.app G ≫ a ≫
            kW.inv.app E ≫ qW.inv.app (L.obj E))
        let b' := eV.functor.preimage
          (qV.hom.app (L.obj G) ≫ kV.hom.app G ≫ b ≫
            kV.inv.app E ≫ qV.inv.app (L.obj E))
        tU.inv.app (L.obj G) ≫ SU.map a' ≫ tU.hom.app (L.obj E) =
          tT.inv.app (L.obj G) ≫ ST.map b' ≫ tT.hom.app (L.obj E)
